summary: CRITICAL: Missing all bats tests (required), fixture JSON files (required), act-result.txt artifact (required), and test harness. Workflow runs script but never validates output. No evidence of TDD (write failing test first). Task explicitly required "start by writing your first failing test" and "all tests must be runnable with bats"—neither delivered. Script itself uses set -euo pipefail, proper quoting, good modularization; but workflow steps (lines 26–56) invoke script without assertions on output, and no test output capture to act-result.txt. Incomplete deliverable.
